name: residual_geometry_corrected
purpose: The corrected residual-geometry analysis that follows a successful pilot reproduction. This file records what it will do; the entry point refuses to execute until the reproduction has passed and the protocol is explicitly approved.
prerequisites: outputs/residual_geometry/pilot_reproduction/validation.json exists and reports all checks passed
the state-45 reproduction gate passed within 1e-06
the protocol below is approved explicitly on the command line

states.numbering: state 0 is the embedding output; states 1-48 are transformer-block outputs
states.degenerate_policy: scored, flagged, and excluded from any maximum

folds.rationale: one split is one draw; repeating the whole cross-validation over many splits turns a point estimate into a distribution and shows how much of the state ranking is split noise
folds.grouping_limitation: no genuine prompt-family identifier exists in the accepted corpus, so folds are label-stratified only; near-duplicate prompts may fall on opposite sides of a boundary

probe.tol_rationale: carried over from the pilot reproduction, where scikit-learn's default tol=1e-04 was shown to stop lbfgs short of the optimum

activation_variants.unit_l2: sample-local unit-L2 normalisation, applied deterministically before StandardScaler; the scaler is then fitted on training rows only
activation_variants.norm_residualised: the linear dependence of every feature on ||x|| removed, with the regression fitted on training rows only
activation_variants.activation_norm: one scalar per example, ||x||_2, with its StandardScaler and classifier fitted on training rows only

nested_selection.rule: the state is chosen by an inner cross-validation inside each outer training fold and scored on the outer held-out rows

permutation.statistic: maximum over searched states of the mean cross-validated ROC-AUC
permutation.rule: the feature matrices and the split assignment are fixed; only the labels are shuffled, deterministically by base_seed + permutation index; every permutation searches every included state and contributes its maximum
permutation.why_this_many: the pilot's 20 permutations floor the p-value at 1/21 = 0.048, uncomfortably close to the 0.0476 it reported; 200 lowers the floor to 0.005

within_source.rule: a source is skipped when either class has fewer than two examples; otherwise the number of folds is capped at the smaller class count, the exact E and B counts are reported, and a small analysis is flagged unstable

corrections_over_the_pilot.state_selection: nested: the state is chosen inside each outer training fold and scored on the outer held-out fold, so the reported number is not a maximum taken on the rows it is reported from
corrections_over_the_pilot.permutation_null: each permutation repeats the complete 49-state search and contributes its maximum, so the null prices the selection; enough permutations to resolve a p-value below the pilot's 1/21 floor
corrections_over_the_pilot.magnitude_confound: the activation-norm control, a unit-L2-normalised probe and a norm-residualised probe are run alongside the raw probe, so the directional component is separated from the magnitude component
corrections_over_the_pilot.fold_construction: sklearn.model_selection.StratifiedKFold throughout, with the assignment written out as a first-class artefact
corrections_over_the_pilot.out_of_fold_coverage: predictions saved for every row at every state, not only the selected one

controls.prompt_token_count: not available: the extraction manifest saved no token-count column, and this package never loads a tokeniser or retokenises a prompt, so no model-token-length control is run and none is reported

categorical_columns.provenance: genuine columns of the accepted dataset; no label is inferred from prompt text

descriptive_geometry.projection_discipline: standardisation and PCA fitted on training rows only; held-out rows projected into that basis

outputs.out_of_fold_predictions: one row per (row_id, label, state, activation variant, repeat, fold) with its predicted probability
outputs.split_assignments: written once, before any probe is fitted, and reused unchanged by every state, variant, control and permutation

smoke_test.purpose: exercise every code path on a small subset so the full run is not the first time anything executes; its numbers are not results and the directory name says so

still_out_of_scope: any analysis of the withheld class
any routing or expert feature extraction
any use of held-out benchmark material
